featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent supermarket with every single grocery item available at very much discounted price.
Located near Shantivan on main road and near Ganesh Mandir, as residential area surrounds it, crowd is always there.
All grocery items are available.
Discount is always there and products are genuine. For example, on every single deodorant you purchase, you get rs.50 off.
They give home delivery of purchased products at the shop.
Billing is fast and hastle free.
I recommend this supermarket strongly for any small purchase.

featured_reviews.name: Arun Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Sweet Home super market is better place for all domestic grocery items. As the store provides home delivery service, it is always crowded. The rates are competitive to online shopping stores.

featured_reviews.name: manisha shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Sweet Home Supar Market is a place where you will get all the things which will be required in day to day life. Quality is good. The price is best and there are some discount offers on a few goods. The product is nicely arranged. When you enter, you can see all brands of shampoo, sanitary pads, soft drinks, chocolates then in the second row you will find groceries and spices. Then all snacks material in the third row.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Its good super market.. all products are of good quality and of right quantity.. but sometimes you feel price is high... But that is secondary.. on most of the product you will find prices are reduced.. but who knows the actual price of that product.. whatever shown to your eyes are fact other than that you never know...

featured_reviews.name: Ramesh Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text: Most of the items needed for home are available of good quality. Displays are nice and items are placed with similar category with different brands can compare for price. Some items are little costlier than nearby grocery shops. Service is excellent.

featured_reviews.name: Aashish More
featured_reviews.review_text: Good option for Grocery products.... You will get many options in each category at discounted cost. Also birthday party supplies and decorations available. You can pay by paytm, cards & cash.

featured_reviews.name: MOHAN VARMA
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice store. New concept. Their sizes are smaller than Dmart and bigger than normal kirana stores. Offers discount on many MRP products. Offers free home delivery for orders above Rs 500

featured_reviews.name: Onkar Cheulkar
featured_reviews.review_text: My mom ordered groceries from this place and total was over Rs. 2000 so as a freebie  the store gave ready to eat Idli and Dosa batter, but to our disgusting surprise we found a dead FLY inside the pack of the batter. We tried calling the customer care but there was no response. We also went to the store and informed about this to the person attending the cash register, he was completely unresponsive at first and rudely told us that no other customers complained about it.Such an unethical behaviour from a shopkeeper is quite Unheard.

featured_reviews.review_text: Kanaiya Super Market  is a great option for anyone looking for a variety of products at reasonable prices, coupled with excellent customer service. The store is well-stocked, with everything from fresh produce and meats to household items and electronics, and the layout is well-organized and easy to navigate. The staff is friendly and helpful, providing excellent customer service and answering any questions you may have. Overall, my shopping experience at Kanaiya Super Market   was great, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and reliable supermarket option.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kirana stores—small, often family-run neighborhood shops—remain at the heart of India’s retail ecosystem, fulfilling daily grocery and household needs. With around 12 to 15 million outlets, they command roughly 90% of the grocery market and represent a key force in the largely unorganized retail sector.
mint
Invest India
Observer Research Foundation

These stores enjoy deep-rooted community trust, offering convenience, personalized service, and even short-term credit—long before digital disruption reshaped shopping behaviors. They also became crucial during crises like the COVID-19 lockdown, stepping in when larger formats and online platforms faltered.

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very pleasant shopping experience at Reliance Smart. The store was well-organized, clean, and easy to navigate, which made finding products convenient and hassle-free. The variety of items available, especially in groceries and daily essentials, was impressive, and the quality met my expectations.
I would also like to appreciate the staff for being courteous and helpful. They were attentive and ready to assist whenever needed, which enhanced the overall experience. The billing process was smooth and efficient, with minimal waiting time.
However, there is still some scope for improvement in maintaining consistent stock availability for certain popular items. Apart from that, everything was excellent.
Overall, I am satisfied with my visit and would definitely recommend Reliance Smart to others for a comfortable and reliable shopping experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ever since Reliance Smart has moved up to the 2nd floor, it has become more organised, and spacious. The items that you are looking for are generally available, but some you might find under combo offers only, or in large packs. The prices obviously are a little higher than D-Mart, and their offers don't entice me ever.

The best thing about Reliance is that it is less crowded than D-Mart, and you can shop peacefully. I guess it is the extra price you pay for. Their rewards system is a joke. In the last year and a half, we must have shopped closed to around Rs.13-15K, and all that we see in our rewards list is a reimbursement amount of Rs. 150.
